why: The step narrows when the store-wide pages tag is refreshed, so its safety rests on listFacts() holding every fact another page, feed or file shows of a page, and the brief leaves that to judgement ('when unsure ... it belongs in listFacts()', stop_if 3 on full-text readers such as llms.txt or search knowledge). Several places also need a design call: place 8 does not exist where the brief says, publishOne() must be reshaped to carry a scope, the alt-text return depends on whether step 0.28 left a lookup, and the product-layout int test's how is self-contradictory.
harm_if_wrong: A publish refreshes only the page's own tag while a menu, grid card, feed, sitemap or AI text elsewhere still shows the old title, excerpt or body for hours, with every unit and int test green.
make_it_cheaper: Settle listFacts() in the brief by naming every reader of a page's content outside its own route (grid, index, menus, sitemaps, llms.txt, search knowledge, feeds) and the field each reads, drop place 8 or name its file, and specify publishOne()'s new Outcome shape; the step would then be cheap-then-review.
brief_problems: Place 8: src/server/owner-tools.ts has no savePage() call at all, and the fallback rg ('savePage\(.*publish: true' in src/server) finds admin-api-content.ts, experiment-tools.ts, dream-factory.ts, store-drafts.ts and page-schedules.ts, so 'the eighth place' is ambiguous and stop_if 6 will fire; the count of nine is not right against the code.
Commit 1's product-layouts int test text contradicts itself (memoising mock, or a spy that 'is not possible', or counting statements); the cheap model cannot tell which assertion to write.
Commit 6 depends on a lookup step 0.28 may or may not have added (media_uses, picture_uses or pagesHolding), with two different behaviours.
The x-nextjs-cache header under cacheComponents is not confirmed (stop_if 1), so the main e2e proof of commit 5 may not be available.
